newsitem.title: UK: Next UK monetary meetings on Feb 5, March 5.
newsitem.headline: Next UK monetary meetings on Feb 5, March 5.

text.p: The next two monetary policy meetings between Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke and Bank of England Governor Eddie George have been provisionally scheduled for February 5 and March 5, the Treasury said.
Minutes of the January 15 meeting, after which interest rates were left unchanged at 6.0 percent, will be published on February 19.
